bio.text: Blake Moore, a Republican and a native of Ogden, has represented Utah in the U.S. House since 2021.
In 2026 he won the June 23 Republican primary for Utah's 2nd Congressional District over state Rep. Karianne Lisonbee and faces Democrat Peter Crosby in November.
According to his House website, he previously served in the Foreign Service at the U.S. Department of State and was a principal at Cicero Group.
He holds a master's in public policy and administration from Northwestern University and graduated from the University of Utah.
